INSERT INTO business_goals (title, description, category, target_value, current_value, unit, start_date, end_date, status, notes) VALUES
('Grow Email List to 3,000 Subscribers', 'Triple subscriber growth through Bookclicker cross-promos, BookFunnel group promos, and optimized reader magnets. Current list has stalled at 1,763 since Dec 2025.', 'subscribers', 3000, 1763, 'subscribers', '2026-03-21', '2026-06-30', 'active', 'Priority actions: 1) Run 2 Bookclicker cross-promos/week 2) Join 3 BookFunnel group promos/month 3) Create new reader magnet for Book 4'),
('Generate First $500 in Website Revenue', 'Launch coaching packages and digital products on reeseastor.com. Currently at $0 revenue. Target romance writing coaching, book description templates, and character development worksheets.', 'revenue', 500, 0, 'dollars', '2026-03-21', '2026-06-30', 'active', 'Revenue streams: 1) Writing coaching 1-on-1 sessions ($97-197) 2) Digital product bundle ($27-47) 3) Masterclass on romance writing ($47)'),
('Publish 12 New Blog Posts (SEO-Optimized)', 'Create consistent content pipeline targeting romance reader keywords. Currently have 7 posts. Target 3 posts/month covering book reviews, writing tips, and trope deep-dives.', 'content', 19, 7, 'published posts', '2026-03-21', '2026-06-30', 'active', 'Content calendar: 1) Weekly romance trope analysis 2) Behind-the-scenes writing posts 3) Reader Q&A posts to boost engagement'),
('Launch New Book Series (Outline + Book 1 Draft)', 'With Manhattan Money Kings complete (4 books, 4.7 avg rating), start a new connected series to drive backlist sales and attract new readers.', 'books', 1, 0, 'book draft completed', '2026-03-21', '2026-09-30', 'active', 'Options: 1) Manhattan Money Kings spinoff (side characters) 2) New billionaire series in different city 3) Connected standalone. Use Digital Maker AI for outlining and research.'),
('Build Social Media Presence (500 Followers)', 'Leverage video tools (HumanPal, TalkingPhotos, Video Express, SoundMadeSeen) to create BookTok/Instagram content. Use Marky for scheduling.', 'social', 500, 0, 'total followers', '2026-03-21', '2026-06-30', 'active', 'Strategy: 1) 3 BookTok videos/week using Video Express 2) Daily Instagram stories with TalkingPhotos 3) Weekly author avatar videos with HumanPal 4) Use Marky for scheduling'),
('Activate All 12 Business Tools', 'Set up and actively use all AppSumo tools. Currently 7/12 active. Need to onboard BookFunnel, FlexiFunnels, Marky, SendFox, and Dynamic Mockups.', 'other', 12, 7, 'tools active', '2026-03-21', '2026-04-30', 'active', 'Priority order: 1) BookFunnel (reader magnet delivery - CRITICAL) 2) FlexiFunnels (sales pages for coaching) 3) Marky (social media scheduling) 4) Dynamic Mockups (book mockups for ads) 5) SendFox (backup email)');
